method: Existing converged background-only fits, r=0; read-only extraction, no new minimization.
correlated_analyses: The two analyses share CR events and must not be added or treated as independent measurements.
nominal_mass: m9.5 source directory only; the zero-signal fit is identical for all signal mass hypotheses within each side.

low.physical_yields: Analytical extended coefficient functions, integrated over the specified regions.
low.error_method: sqrt(J V J^T), with complete native fit covariance and numerical local derivatives. Means and normalizations both included; all inter-parameter and inter-era correlations retained.
low.error_interpretation: Approximate symmetric one-standard-deviation Hesse errors; not profile-likelihood intervals or externally calibrated normalization constraints.
